note: A jury that cannot reach the required agreement on a verdict, leading to a mistrial; procedures vary by legal system.

senses.m: A jury that cannot reach the required agreement on a verdict, leading to a mistrial
senses.pat: a hung jury cannot agree · declare a hung jury · result in a hung jury
ex: The trial ended after the jury became deadlocked.
Phiên tòa kết thúc sau khi bồi thẩm đoàn không đạt được đồng thuận.
A hung jury may lead to a retrial.
Bồi thẩm đoàn bế tắc có thể dẫn đến xét xử lại.

note: A protest in which participants deliberately refuse food; health risks can become severe and the term should be used accurately.

senses.m: A protest in which participants deliberately refuse food
senses.pat: go on a hunger strike · end a hunger strike · a prolonged hunger strike
ex: The detainees began a hunger strike to demand legal access.
Những người bị giam bắt đầu tuyệt thực để yêu cầu được tiếp cận pháp lý.
Doctors monitored the health of the hunger strikers.
Bác sĩ theo dõi sức khỏe của những người tuyệt thực.

note: An area where people hunt animals; figuratively, a place where someone searches for opportunities, targets, or customers.

senses.m: An area where people hunt animals
senses.pat: a hunting ground for · hunting grounds in the forest · a recruiting hunting ground
ex: The valley is a traditional hunting ground for local communities.
Thung lũng là khu vực săn bắn truyền thống của cộng đồng địa phương.
The trade fair is a hunting ground for new clients.
Hội chợ thương mại là nơi tìm kiếm khách hàng mới.

note: A large mass of permanent ice covering a relatively small area of land, smaller than an ice sheet; also sometimes used loosely for polar ice.

senses.m: A large mass of permanent ice covering a relatively small area of land, smaller than an ice sheet
senses.pat: an ice cap melts · a mountain ice cap · polar ice cap
ex: The mountain ice cap has shrunk over recent decades.
Chỏm băng trên núi đã thu hẹp trong những thập kỷ gần đây.
Researchers measured the thickness of the ice cap.
Các nhà nghiên cứu đo độ dày của chỏm băng.

note: A heavy club-shaped exercise implement used for swinging motions; also called an Indian club in historical fitness terminology. The name is colonial-era and dated.

senses.m: A heavy club-shaped exercise implement used for swinging motions
senses.pat: swing Indian clubs · an Indian-club exercise · a pair of clubs
ex: The athlete practiced controlled swings with wooden clubs.
Vận động viên tập các động tác vung tạ gỗ có kiểm soát.
The museum displayed antique Indian clubs used for exercise.
Bảo tàng trưng bày những quả tạ tập thể dục kiểu cổ.

note: The third-largest ocean, lying between Africa, Asia, Australia, and the Southern Ocean; capitalize the proper name.

senses.m: The third-largest ocean, lying between Africa, Asia, Australia, and the Southern Ocean
senses.pat: across the Indian Ocean · Indian Ocean islands · Indian Ocean trade
ex: The ship crossed the Indian Ocean in six weeks.
Con tàu vượt Ấn Độ Dương trong sáu tuần.
Monsoon winds shape shipping routes in the Indian Ocean.
Gió mùa định hình các tuyến hàng hải ở Ấn Độ Dương.

note: A period of unusually warm, dry weather in autumn in parts of North America; usage and timing vary by region. The term is culturally dated and alternatives such as warm autumn spell may be preferred.

senses.m: A period of unusually warm, dry weather in autumn in parts of North America
senses.pat: an Indian summer in October · enjoy an Indian summer · late Indian summer
ex: A warm spell in October extended the hiking season.
Một đợt thời tiết ấm vào tháng Mười kéo dài mùa đi bộ đường dài.
The forecast called it an unusually mild autumn, not an Indian summer.
Dự báo gọi đó là mùa thu ấm bất thường, không dùng tên gọi cũ.

note: The use of computers, software, and networks to store, process, and communicate information; often abbreviated IT.

senses.m: The use of computers, software, and networks to store, process, and communicate information
senses.pat: information technology services · IT department · study information technology
ex: She works in information technology for a hospital.
Cô làm về công nghệ thông tin cho một bệnh viện.
The course covers information technology and cybersecurity.
Khóa học bao gồm công nghệ thông tin và an ninh mạng.

note: A small group of people close to and trusted by a leader or organization; can imply exclusivity.

senses.m: A small group of people close to and trusted by a leader or organization
senses.pat: belong to the inner circle · a leader’s inner circle · keep someone outside the inner circle
ex: Only members of the minister’s inner circle knew about the plan.
Chỉ những người thân cận với bộ trưởng biết về kế hoạch.
The company’s inner circle made the final decision.
Nhóm lãnh đạo thân cận của công ty đưa ra quyết định cuối cùng.

note: The central urban area of a city, often referring to older, densely populated neighborhoods; in some contexts associated with economic disadvantage, so avoid treating that as universal.

senses.m: The central urban area of a city, often referring to older, densely populated neighborhoods
senses.pat: inner-city schools · live in the inner city · inner-city neighborhoods
ex: The program supports small businesses in the inner city.
Chương trình hỗ trợ doanh nghiệp nhỏ ở khu vực nội đô.
The city invested in parks across several inner-city neighborhoods.
Thành phố đầu tư công viên ở một số khu dân cư nội đô.

note: The part of the ear containing structures for hearing and balance, including the cochlea and vestibular system.

senses.m: The part of the ear containing structures for hearing and balance, including the cochlea and vestibular system
senses.pat: the inner ear controls balance · inner-ear infection · damage to the inner ear
ex: The inner ear helps the body maintain balance.
Tai trong giúp cơ thể duy trì thăng bằng.
An infection affected the structures of her inner ear.
Một bệnh nhiễm trùng ảnh hưởng đến các cấu trúc ở tai trong.

note: The principal judicial organ of the United Nations, which settles legal disputes between states and gives advisory opinions; distinct from the International Criminal Court.

senses.m: The principal judicial organ of the United Nations, which settles legal disputes between states and gives advisory opinions
senses.pat: the International Court of Justice in The Hague · bring a case before the ICJ · ICJ ruling
ex: The case was brought before the International Court of Justice.
Vụ việc được đưa ra trước Tòa án Công lý Quốc tế.
The court gives judgments in disputes between states.
Tòa đưa ra phán quyết trong các tranh chấp giữa các quốc gia.

note: A cocktail traditionally made with hot coffee, Irish whiskey, sugar, and cream; recipes and serving styles vary.

senses.m: A cocktail traditionally made with hot coffee, Irish whiskey, sugar, and cream
senses.pat: a glass of Irish coffee · make Irish coffee · Irish coffee with cream
ex: The café served Irish coffee after dinner.
Quán phục vụ cà phê Ireland pha whiskey sau bữa tối.
He topped the drink with lightly whipped cream.
Anh phủ lên thức uống một lớp kem đánh nhẹ.

note: An informal musical performance in which musicians improvise together, often jazz; can also mean an informal collaborative session in other fields.

senses.m: An informal musical performance in which musicians improvise together, often jazz
senses.pat: join a jam session · a late-night jazz jam session · improvise at a jam session
ex: The musicians joined a jam session after the concert.
Các nhạc công tham gia buổi ứng tấu ngẫu hứng sau buổi hòa nhạc.
The band’s jam session lasted until midnight.
Buổi chơi nhạc ngẫu hứng của ban nhạc kéo dài đến nửa đêm.

note: An engine that produces thrust by expelling a high-speed stream of gases; used in aircraft and other applications.

senses.m: An engine that produces thrust by expelling a high-speed stream of gases
senses.pat: a jet engine starts · jet-engine noise · develop a jet engine
ex: The aircraft’s jet engines were inspected before takeoff.
Động cơ phản lực của máy bay được kiểm tra trước khi cất cánh.
The company designs small jet engines for business aircraft.
Công ty thiết kế động cơ phản lực nhỏ cho máy bay thương gia.

note: A wealthy, fashionable group who travel frequently by private or commercial jet; often used critically or playfully.

senses.m: A wealthy, fashionable group who travel frequently by private or commercial jet
senses.pat: the international jet set · a jet-set lifestyle · jet-set destinations
ex: The resort became popular with the international jet set.
Khu nghỉ dưỡng trở nên nổi tiếng với giới thượng lưu thường xuyên đi máy bay.
The novel satirizes the jet set’s extravagant lifestyle.
Tiểu thuyết châm biếm lối sống xa hoa của giới thượng lưu du lịch nhiều.

note: A personification of England or the English, depicted as a stout, middle-aged man; can also refer informally to a stereotypical Englishman.

senses.m: A personification of England or the English, depicted as a stout, middle-aged man
senses.pat: John Bull character · John Bull imagery · a cartoon of John Bull
ex: The political cartoon portrayed John Bull weighing his options.
Bức biếm họa chính trị mô tả hình tượng John Bull cân nhắc các lựa chọn.
The expression John Bull is now mostly historical or humorous.
Cách gọi John Bull nay chủ yếu mang tính lịch sử hoặc hài hước.

note: A star-shaped exercise movement involving jumping while spreading the legs and raising the arms; also a toy or mechanical device with moving limbs.

senses.m: A star-shaped exercise movement involving jumping while spreading the legs and raising the arms
senses.pat: do jumping jacks · a set of jumping jacks · jumping-jack exercise
ex: The coach asked the team to do twenty jumping jacks.
Huấn luyện viên yêu cầu cả đội thực hiện hai mươi động tác bật nhảy dang tay chân.
The children played with a wooden jumping jack puppet.
Bọn trẻ chơi con rối gỗ có tay chân chuyển động.

note: Food high in calories, salt, sugar, or fat and low in nutritional value; informal and sometimes judgmental, so identify specific foods when precision matters.

senses.m: Food high in calories, salt, sugar, or fat and low in nutritional value
senses.pat: eat/avoid junk food · junk-food advertising · cut down on junk food
ex: The school restricted junk-food sales during lunch.
Trường hạn chế bán đồ ăn vặt ít dinh dưỡng trong giờ trưa.
They packed fruit instead of junk food for the trip.
Họ mang trái cây thay cho đồ ăn vặt ít dinh dưỡng trong chuyến đi.

note: Unwanted advertising or promotional mail, delivered physically or electronically; email version is often called spam.

senses.m: Unwanted advertising or promotional mail, delivered physically or electronically
senses.pat: receive/get junk mail · throw junk mail away · filter junk mail
ex: The mailbox was full of junk mail.
Hộp thư đầy thư quảng cáo không mong muốn.
A spam filter moved the junk mail out of her inbox.
Bộ lọc thư rác chuyển thư quảng cáo ra khỏi hộp thư đến.
